notes.title: 1.0.2 Live!
notes.content:
- Fixed tutorial appearing low-res
- Fixed red vignette from low health not updating
- Fixed Potassium explosion sounds not being controlled by any SFX slider
- Fixed explosion sounds being too loud when multiple play simultaneously
- Fixed Potassium explosion not affecting the boss
- Fixed some stray particles on element icons on the upgrade screen

Hurt my hand, so sadly no long description today - thanks for playing, as always!

notes.title: LEO 1.0.1 released!
notes.content: [p]Hi folks! This is the first of the bugfix patches LEO will receive as reports come in. Thank you to everyone who's provided feedback so far! It's always remarkable how much more playtesting gets done the moment you release something to the public, compared to what you can do on your own.[/p][p][/p][p]I'm glad to say that none of the reported bugs were game-breaking, which makes this a pretty smooth launch! That said, I'd like to keep pushing for as bug-free of an experience as possible. I've also tweaked the endless progression parameters to hopefully make it a more fair, but still challenging experience![/p][p][/p][p]Fixed issues:[/p][list][*][p]Enemies not being cleared post-boss[/p][/*][*][p]Boss looking like a melee enemy when firing missiles[/p][/*][*][p]Some sound effects not being affected by the correct options[/p][/*][*][p]Sliders were only clickable once[/p][/*][*][p]LEO could exit the arena at high enough speeds; this is hard to fix permanently due to Godot's physics, but LEO will at least be put back in the center of the arena[/p][/*][*][p]Upgrades in endless mode would affect the record created post-boss; unfortunately I can't fix results retroactively, but future results should be separate between victory and endless mode[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Lastly, a big thank you to everyone who's played LEO - I'm so glad to have created a fun experience for you! I hope you'll continue to play and share it with your friends![/p]

notes.title: Liftoff!
notes.content: [p]And we're live on the Steam store! I hope you all have a great time playing LEO! I'll be keeping an eye out for any reported issues, but feel free to reach out to me at contact@birdti.me![/p][p][/p][p]It's always a daunting thing, putting something you've worked on out there. I'm not sure what comes next, but if nothing else, I really do think I've built something pretty fun, so I'm glad people will be able to try it! I think the next few days will be spent handling marketing and writing up some retrospectives about the development process, but I'm also planning a few ways to expand the game if there's interest.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun, and fly safe![/p]

notes.title: Clarifying release date
notes.content: [p]Hi folks! Thank you to everyone who's helped LEO get this far - the launch is super close and it's an exciting time! There was a small mixup on the launch date - the earliest I can hit Release is the midnight of June 30th, but unfortunately the displayed launch time was 12:00pm. Sorry for the extra wait! I'm very excited for you all to play it in 12 hours![/p][p][/p][p]On a personal note, this is my first time doing a Steam release - I'm hoping it'll go as smoothly as possible, but I'll be around and ready to fix any issues that crop up! I welcome any feedback if things aren't working as they should![/p]
